description: This file is a plugin script for CKEditor integrating CodeMirror for enhanced source code editing with syntax highlighting, line numbers, and other features. It defines plugin initialization, configuration, dialog overrides, and command customizations specific to the CodeMirror integration within CKEditor.

classes.name: sourceEditable
classes.description: A custom CKEDITOR editable class that integrates CodeMirror for source editing, providing methods for setting and getting data, detaching, and handling read-only state.

methods.name: loadCodeMirrorInline
methods.description: Initializes a CodeMirror instance within a CKEditor source dialog, setting up configuration, event handlers, and UI adjustments.

methods.name: getCodeMirrorDependencies
methods.description: Returns dependencies required for loading CodeMirror modules via require.js.

methods.name: getCodeMirrorScripts
methods.description: Returns list of script URLs for CodeMirror core and addons.

methods.name: IsStyleSheetAlreadyLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a stylesheet is already loaded in the document.

methods.name: OffSetToLineChannel
methods.description: Converts text offset to line and character position in CodeMirror.

methods.name: getCodeMirrorScripts
methods.description: Returns list of script URLs for CodeMirror core and addons based on configuration mode.
